steps.en: Received notices are stored so they can be reported on
steps.id: Notice yang diterima disimpan sehingga bisa dilaporkan

steps.en: The report can be run for a chosen day or date range
steps.id: Report bisa dibuat untuk hari atau rentang tanggal yang dipilih

steps.en: The report is generated automatically every day
steps.why_en: No scheduled job exists; the report is only built when someone presses Export.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada job terjadwal; report hanya dibuat saat seseorang menekan Export.

steps.en: The report summarises totals received, successful and failed
steps.id: Report merangkum total diterima, berhasil, dan gagal
steps.why_en: Some rejected notices are counted in the total but missing from the failed count and sheets.
steps.why_id: Sebagian notice yang ditolak masuk total tetapi tidak ada di hitungan gagal dan di sheet.

steps.en: The report lists the details of every notice received
steps.id: Report memuat detail setiap notice yang diterima

steps.en: The report is routed to the OIC's dashboard
steps.why_en: It sits in the general Report menu; nothing sends it to an OIC dashboard.
steps.why_id: Report ada di menu Report umum; tidak ada yang mengirimnya ke dashboard OIC.

steps.en: The OIC can download the report as an Excel file
steps.id: OIC bisa mengunduh report sebagai file Excel
